highlights.title: Plan limits in Settings
highlights.line: Settings, AI Models now shows a Claude account's 5-hour limit, and a ChatGPT sign-in's limits as Codex last reported them.

highlights.title: Accounts on your other computers
highlights.line: Opened from your Kosmos+ address, Settings, AI Models also lists your other computers' Claude accounts, weekly usage and agents.

highlights.title: Stop an account move
highlights.line: A move of several agents to another account can now be stopped; agents it had not reached keep their old account.

highlights.title: Every permission choice is a button
highlights.line: A Claude agent's permission question shows every choice as a button; one that changes what it may do from now on needs a second press.

highlights.title: An agent needs no project
highlights.line: Agents do not need a project: the No project tile on the Agents board is gone, and a new team's Project is optional.
